name: guardrail-serve-original-v1
description: Small original French/English corpus with positive and negative cases for detect_secret, detect_pii and prompt_injection. All values are fictional.
label_semantics: detect_secret: the text contains a credential (password, API key, token, URL credentials). detect_pii: the text contains an email address, French phone number, IBAN, IPv4 address or payment card number; names and postal addresses are out of scope and left unlabelled. prompt_injection: the text tries to override instructions, reveal hidden prompts or disable safeguards. Tag hard marks cases that stress known heuristic limits.
